summary: Enable NX-API on a new switch over CLI with nxos_nxapi enable_http/enable_https, then switch group_vars to the httpapi connection.
questions: How do I enable NX-API on a Nexus switch with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Enable NX-API
answer_card.answer_md:
Using the CLI group_vars:
```yaml
- name: Enable NX-API
  cisco.nxos.nxos_nxapi:
    enable_http: yes
    enable_https: yes
  when: ansible_network_os == 'cisco.nxos.nxos'
```
Then change `group_vars/nxos.yml` to `ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.httpapi`.
